jaṁ davvaṁ udagāisu chūḍhamahē vayai jaṁ ca bhārēṇaṁ
sīīē rajjuēṇa va ōyaraṇaṁ davva'hēkammaṁ // PiṇḍNi.116
sañjamaṭhāṇāṇaṁ kaṇḍagāṇa lēsā-ṭhiī-visēsāṇaṁ
bhāvaṁ ahē karēī tamhā taṁ bhāva'hēkammaṁ ।। gāhā-118 // PiṇḍNi.117
tatthānantā u carittapajjavā honti sañjamaṭṭhāṇaṁ
saṅkhaiyāṇi u tāṇi kaṇḍagaṁ hōi nāyavvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.118
saṅkhāīyāṇi u kaṇḍagāṇi chaṭṭhāṇagaṁ viniddiṭṭhaṁ
chaṭṭhāṇā u asaṅkhā sañjamasēḍhī muṇēyavvā // PiṇḍNi.119
kiṇhāiyā u lēsā ukkōsavisuddhiṭhiivisēsāō
ēēsi visuddhāṇaṁ appaṁ taggāhagō kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.120
bhāvōvayāramāhēumappagē kiñcinūṇa caraṇaggō
āhākammaggāhī ahō ahō nēi appāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.121
bandhai ahē bhavāū pakarēi ahōmuhāiṁ kammāiṁ
ghanakaraṇaṁ tivvēṇa u bhāvēṇa caō uvacaō ya // PiṇḍNi.122
tēsi gurūṇamudaēṇa appagaṁ duggaīē pavaḍantaṁ
na caēi vidhārēuṁ aharagatiṁ ninti kammāiṁ // PiṇḍNi.123
aṭṭhāē aṇaṭṭhāē chakkāyapamaddaṇaṁ tu jō kuṇai
aniyāē ya niyāē āyāhammaṁ tayaṁ benti // PiṇḍNi.124
jāṇantu ajāṇantō tahēva niddisiya ōhaō vā'vi
jāṇagamajāṇagē vā vahēi aniyā niyā ēsā // PiṇḍNi.125
davvāyā khalu kāyā bhāvāyā tinni nāṇamāīṇi
parapāṇapāḍaṇaraō caraṇāyaṁ appaṇō haṇai // PiṇḍNi.126
nicchayanayassa caraṇāya vidhāē nāṇadaṁsaṇavahō'vi
vavahārassa u caraṇē hayammi bhayaṇā u sēsāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.127
davvammi attakammaṁ jaṁ jō u mamāyaē tagaṁ davvaṁ
bhāvē asuhapariṇaō parakammaṁ attaṇō kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.128
āhākammapariṇaō phāsuyamavi saṅkiliṭṭhapariṇāmō
āiyamāṇō bajjhai taṁ jāṇasu attakammanti // PiṇḍNi.129
parakamma attakammīkarēi taṁ jō u giṇhiuṁ bhuñjē
tattha bhavē parakiriyā kahaṁ nu annatthaṁ saṅkamaī? // PiṇḍNi.130
kūḍauvamāi kēī parappauttē'vi bentiṁ bandhotti
bhaṇai gurūvi pamattō bajjhai kūḍē adakkhō ya // PiṇḍNi.131
ēmēva bhāvakūḍē bajjhai jō asubhabhāvapariṇāmō
tamhā u asubhabhāvō vajjēyavvō payattēṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.132
kāmaṁ sayaṁ na kuvvai jāṇantō puṇa tahāvi taggāhī
vaḍḍhēi tappasaṅgaṁ agiṇhamāṇō u vārēi // PiṇḍNi.133
attīkarēi kammaṁ paḍisēvāīhiṁ taṁ puṇa imēhiṁ
tattha gurū āipayaṁ lahu lahu lahugā kamēṇiyarē ।। gāhā-135 // PiṇḍNi.134
paḍisēvaṇamāīṇaṁ dārāṇa'numōyaṇā-vasāṇāṇaṁ
jahasambhavaṁ sarūvaṁ sōdāharaṇaṁ pavakkhāmi // PiṇḍNi.135
annēṇāhākammaṁ uvanīyaṁ asai cōiō bhaṇai
parahatthēṇaṅgārē kaḍḍhantō jaha na ḍajjhai hu // PiṇḍNi.136
ēvaṁ khu suddhō dōsō dentassa kūḍauvamāē
samayatthamajāṇantō mūḍhō paḍisēvaṇaṁ kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.137
uvaōgammi ya lābhaṁ kammaggāhissa cittarakkhaṭṭhā
ālōiē suladdhaṁ bhaṇai bhaṇantassa paḍisuṇaṇā // PiṇḍNi.138
saṁvāsō u pasiddhō anumōyaṇa kammabhōyagapasaṁsā
ēēsimudāharaṇā ēē u kamēṇa nāyavvā // PiṇḍNi.139
paḍisēvaṇāē tēṇā paḍisuṇaṇāē u rāyaputtō u
saṁvāsammi ya pallī anumōyaṇa rāyaduṭṭhō ya // PiṇḍNi.140
gōṇīharaṇa sabhūmī nēūṇaṁ gōṇiō pahē bhakkhē
nivvisayā parivēsaṇa ṭhiyāvi tē kūviyā ghatthē // PiṇḍNi.141
jē'viya parivēsantī bhāyaṇāṇi dharanti ya
tē'vi bajjhanti tivvēṇakammuṇā kimu bhōiṇō? // PiṇḍNi.142
sāmatthaṇa rāyasuē piivahaṇa sahāya taha ya tuṇhikkō
tiṇhampi hu paḍisuṇaṇā raṇṇā siṭṭhammi sā natthi // PiṇḍNi.143
bhuñja na bhuñjē bhuñjasu taiō tusiṇīu bhuñjaē paḍhamō
tiṇhampi hu paḍisuṇaṇā paḍisēhantassa sā natthi // PiṇḍNi.144
āṇettubhuñjagā kammuṇā u bīyassa vāiō dōsō
taiyassa ya mānasiō tīhiṁ visuddhō cautthō u // PiṇḍNi.145
paḍisēvaṇa paḍisuṇaṇā saṁvāsa'numōyaṇā u caurō vi
piyamāragarāyasuē vibhāsiyavvā jaijaṇē'vi // PiṇḍNi.146
pallīvahammi naṭṭhā cōrā vaṇiyā vayaṁ na cōratti
na palāṇā pāvakara tti kāuṁ rannā uvāladdhā // PiṇḍNi.147
āhākaḍabhōīhiṁ sahavāsō taha ya tavvivajjampi
daṁsaṇagandha parikahā bhāvinti sulūhavittimpi // PiṇḍNi.148
rāyōrōha'varāhē vibhūsiō ghāiō nayaramajjhē
dhannādhannatti kahā vahāvahō kappaḍiyakhōlā // PiṇḍNi.149
sāuṁ pajjattaṁ āyarēṇa kālē riukkhamaṁ niddhaṁ
tagguṇavikatthaṇāē abhuñjamāṇē'vi aṇumannā // PiṇḍNi.150
āhā ahē ya kammē āyāhammē ya attakammē ya
jaha vañjaṇanāṇattaṁ atthēṇa'vi pucchaē ēvaṁ ।। gāhā-152 // PiṇḍNi.151
ēgaṭṭhā ēgavañjaṇa ēgaṭṭhā nāṇavañjaṇā cēva
nāṇaṭṭha ēgavañjaṇa nāṇaṭṭhā vañjaṇānāṇā // PiṇḍNi.152
diṭṭhaṁ khīraṁ khīraṁ ēgaṭṭhaṁ ēgavañjaṇaṁ lōē
ēgaṭṭhaṁ bahunāmaṁ duddha paō pīlu khīraṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.153
gōmahisiayākhīraṁ nāṇaṭṭhaṁ ēgavañjaṇaṁ lōē
ghaḍapaḍasagaḍarahāī hōi pihatthaṁ pihaṁnāmaṁ // PiṇḍNi.154
āhākammāīṇaṁ hōi duruttāiṁ paḍhamabhaṅgō u
āhāhēkammanti ya biiō sakkinda iva bhaṅgō // PiṇḍNi.155
āhākammantariyā asaṇāīṁ u caurō taiyabhaṅgō
āhākamma paḍuccā niyamā sunnō carimabhaṅgō // PiṇḍNi.156
indatthaṁ jaha saddā purandarāī u nāivattantē
ahakamma āyahammā taha āhaṁ nāivattantē // PiṇḍNi.157
āhākammēṇa ahē karēti jaṁ haṇai pāṇabhūyāiṁ
jaṁ taṁ āiyamāṇō parakammaṁ attaṇō kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.158
kassatti pucchiyaṁmī niyamā sāhammiyassa taṁ hōi
sāhammiyassa tamhā kāyavva parūvaṇā vihiṇā // PiṇḍNi.159
nāmaṁ ṭhavaṇā daviē khettē kālē ya pavayaṇē liṅgē
daṁsaṇa nāṇa carittē abhiggahē bhāvaṇāō ya // PiṇḍNi.160
nāmammi sarisanāmō ṭhavaṇāē kaṭṭhakammamāīyā
davvammi jō u bhaviō sāhammisarīragaṁ jaṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.161
khettē samāṇadēvī kālammi samāṇa kālasambhūō
pavayaṇi saṅghēgayarō liṅgē rayaharaṇa muhapottī // PiṇḍNi.162
daṁsaṇa nāṇē caraṇē tiga paṇa paṇa tiviha hōi u carittē
davvāiō abhiggaha aha bhāvaṇamō aniccāī // PiṇḍNi.163
jāvanta dēvadattā gihī va agihīva tēsi dāhāmi
nō kappaī gihīṇaṁ dāhanti visēsiyaṁ kappē // PiṇḍNi.164
pāsaṇḍīsu na vi ēvaṁ mīsāmīsēsu hōi hu vibhāsā
samaṇēsu sañjayāṇa u visarisanāmāṇavi na kappē // PiṇḍNi.165
nīsamanīsā va kaḍaṁ ṭhavaṇāsāhammiyammi u vibhāsā
davvē mayataṇubhattaṁ na taṁ tu kucchā vivajjejjā // PiṇḍNi.166
pāsaṇḍiyasamaṇāṇaṁ gihinigganthāṇaṁ cēva u vibhāsā
jaha nāmammi tahēva ya khettē kālē ya nāyavvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.167
dasa sasihāgā sāvaga pavayaṇasāhammiyā na liṅgēṇa
liṅgēṇa u sāhammī nō pavayaṇa niṇhagā savvē ।। gāhā-169 // PiṇḍNi.168
visarisadaṁsaṇajuttā pavayaṇasāhammiyā na daṁsaṇaō
titthagarā pattēyā nō pavayaṇadaṁsa sāhammī // PiṇḍNi.169
nāṇacarittā ēvaṁ nāyavvā honti pavayaṇēṇaṁ tu
pavayaṇaō sāhammī nābhiggahasāvagā jaiṇō // PiṇḍNi.170
sāhamma'bhiggahēṇaṁ nō pavayaṇa niṇha tittha pattēyā
ēvaṁ pavayaṇabhāvaṇa ettō sēsāṇa vocchāmi // PiṇḍNi.171
liṅgāīhivi ēvaṁ ekkekkēṇaṁ tu uvarimā nēyā
jē'nannē uvarillā tē mottuṁ sēsaē ēvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.172
liṅgēṇa u sāhammī na daṁsaṇē vīsudaṁsi jainiṇhā
pattēyabuddha titthaṅkarā ya bīyammi bhaṅgammi // PiṇḍNi.173
liṅgēṇa u nābhiggaha aṇabhiggaha vīsu'bhiggahā cēva
jaisāvaga biyabhaṅgē pattēyabuhā ya titthayarā // PiṇḍNi.174
ēvaṁ liṅgēṇa bhāvaṇa daṁsaṇanāṇē ya paḍhamabhaṅgō u
jaisāvaga visunāṇī ēvaṁ ciya biiyabhaṅgō'vi // PiṇḍNi.175
daṁsaṇacaraṇē paḍhamō sāvaga jaiṇō ya bīyabhaṅgō u
jaiṇō visarisadaṁsī daṁsē ya abhiggahē vocchaṁ // PiṇḍNi.176
sāvaga jai vīsa'bhiggaha paḍhamō bīō ya bhāvanā cēvaṁ
nāṇēṇa'vi nejjēvaṁ ettō caraṇēṇa vocchāmi // PiṇḍNi.177
jaiṇō vīsābhiggaha paḍhamō biya niṇhasāvagajaiṇō u
ēvaṁ tu bhāvaṇāsu'vi vocchaṁ dōṇhantimāṇittō // PiṇḍNi.178
jaiṇō sāvaga niṇhava paḍhamē biiē ya hunti bhaṅgē ya
kēvalanāṇē titthaṅkarassa nō kappai kayaṁ tu // PiṇḍNi.179
pattēyabuddha niṇhava uvāsaē kēvalī vi āsajja
khaiyāiē ya bhāvē paḍucca bhaṅgē u jōejjā // PiṇḍNi.180
jattha u taiō bhaṅgō tattha na kappaṁ tu sēsaē bhayaṇā
titthaṅkarakēvaliṇō jaha kappaṁ nō ya sēsāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.181
kiṁ taṁ āhākammanti pucchiē tassarūvakahaṇatthaṁ
sambhavapadarisaṇatthaṁ ca tassa asaṇāiyaṁ bhaṇai // PiṇḍNi.182
sālīmāī avaḍē phalē ya suṇṭhāi sāimaṁ hōi
tassa kaḍaniṭṭhiyaṁmī suddhamasuddhē ya cattāri // PiṇḍNi.183
koddavarālagagāmē vasahī ramaṇijja bhikkha sajjhāē
khettapaḍilēhasañjaya sāvayapucchujjuē kahaṇā // PiṇḍNi.184
jujjai gaṇassa khettaṁ navari gurūṇaṁ tu natthi pāuggaṁ
sālitti kaē rumpaṇa paribhāyaṇa niyayagēhēsu ।। gāhā-186 // PiṇḍNi.185
vōlintā tē va annē vā aḍantā tattha gōyaraṁ
suṇanti ēsaṇājuttā bālādijanasaṅkahā // PiṇḍNi.186
ēē tē jēsimō raddhō sālikūrō gharē gharē
dinnō vā sēsayaṁ dēmi dēhi vā binti vā imaṁ // PiṇḍNi.187
thakkē thakkāvaḍiyaṁ abhattaē sālibhattayaṁ jāyaṁ
majjha ya paissa maraṇaṁ diyarassa ya sē mayā bhajjā // PiṇḍNi.188
cāulōdagampi sē dēhi sālīāyāmakañjiyaṁ
kimēyanti kayaṁ nāuṁ ? vajjanta'nnaṁ vayanti ya // PiṇḍNi.189
lōṇāgaḍōdaē ēvaṁ khāṇittu mahurōdagaṁ
ḍhakkiēṇa'cchatē tāva jāva sāhutti āgayā // PiṇḍNi.190
kakkaḍiya ambagā vā dāḍima dakkhā ya bīyapūrāī
khāima'higaraṇakaraṇanti sāimaṁ tigaḍugāīyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.191
asaṇāīṇa cauṇhavi āmaṁ jaṁ sāhugahaṇapāuggaṁ
taṁ niṭṭhiyaṁ viyāṇasu uvakkhaḍaṁ tū kaḍaṁ hōi // PiṇḍNi.192
kaṇḍiyatiguṇukkaṇḍā u niṭṭhiyā nēgaduguṇakaṇḍā u
niṭṭhiyakaḍō u kūrō āhākammaṁ duguṇamāhu // PiṇḍNi.193
chāyampi vivajjantī kēī phalahēugāivuttassa
taṁ tu na jujjai jamhā phalampi kappaṁ biiyabhaṅgē // PiṇḍNi.194
parapaccaiyā chāyā navi sā rukkhovvaṁ vaṭṭiyā kattā
naṭṭhacchāē u dumē kappai ēvaṁ bhaṇantassa // PiṇḍNi.195
vaḍḍhai hāyai chāyā tacchikkaṁ pūiyampiva na kappē
na ya āhāya suvihiē nivvattayaī ravicchāyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.196
aghanaghanacārigagaṇē chāyā naṭṭhā diyā puṇō hōi
kappai nirāyavē nāma āyavē taṁ vivajjēuṁ // PiṇḍNi.197
tamhā na ēsa dōsō sambhavaī kammalakkhaṇavihūṇō
tampiya hu aighillā vajjēmāṇā adōsillā // PiṇḍNi.198
parapakkhō u gihatthā samaṇā samaṇīu hōi u sapakkhō
phāsukaḍaṁ raddhaṁ vā niṭṭhiyamiyaraṁ kaḍaṁ savvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.199
tassa kaḍaniṭṭhiyaṁmī annassa kaḍammi niṭṭhiē tassa
caubhaṅgō ittha bhavē caramadugē hōi kappaṁ tu // PiṇḍNi.200
caurō aikkama vaikkamō ya aiyāra taha anāyārō
niddarisaṇa cauṇhavi āhākammē nimantaṇayā // PiṇḍNi.201
sālīghayagulagōrasa navēsu vallīphalēsu jāēsuṁ
dānē ahigamasaḍḍhē āhāya kaē nimantēi ।। gāhā-203 // PiṇḍNi.202
āhākammaggahaṇē aikammāīsu vaṭṭaē causu
nēurahāriga hatthī cautiga dugaēga calaṇēṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.203
āhākammāmantaṇa paḍisuṇamāṇē aikkamō hōi
payabhēyāu vaikkama gahiē taiēyarō giliē // PiṇḍNi.204
āṇāiṇō ya dōsā gahaṇē jaṁ bhaṇiyamaha imē tē u
āṇābhaṅga'ṇavatthā micchatta virāhaṇā cēva // PiṇḍNi.205
āṇaṁ savvajiṇāṇaṁ giṇhantō taṁ aikkamai luddhō
āṇaṁ ca'ikkamantō kassāēsā kuṇai sēsaṁ ? // PiṇḍNi.206
ekkēṇa kayamakajjaṁ karēi tappaccayā puṇō annō
sāyābahula parampara vocchēō sañjamatavāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.207
jō jahavāyaṁ na kuṇaī micchaddiṭṭhī taō hu kō annō ?
vaḍḍhēi ya micchattaṁ parassa saṅkaṁ jaṇēmāṇō // PiṇḍNi.208
vaḍḍhēi tappasaṅgaṁ gēhī ya parassa appaṇō cēva
sajiyampi bhinnadāḍhō na muyai niddhandhasō pacchā // PiṇḍNi.209
khaddhē niddhē ya ruyā suttē hānī tigicchaṇē kāyā
paḍiyaragāṇavi hānī kuṇai kilēsaṁ kilissantō // PiṇḍNi.210
jaha kammaṁ tu akappaṁ tacchikkaṁ vā'vi bhāyaṇaṭhiyaṁ vā
pariharaṇaṁ tassēva ya gahiyamadōsaṁ ca taha bhaṇai // PiṇḍNi.211
abbhojjē gamaṇāi ya pucchā davvakuladēsa bhāvē ya
ēva jayantē chalaṇā diṭṭhantā tatthimē donni // PiṇḍNi.212
jaha vantaṁ tu abhojjaṁ bhattaṁ jaiviya susakkayaṁ āsi
ēvamasañjamavamanē anēsaṇijjaṁ abhojjaṁ tu // PiṇḍNi.213
majjārakhaiyamaṁsā maṁsāsitthi kuṇimaṁ suṇayavantaṁ
vannāi annamuppāiyanti kiṁ taṁ bhavē bhojjaṁ ? // PiṇḍNi.214
kēī bhaṇanti pahiē aṭṭhāṇē maṁsapēsivōsiraṇaṁ
sambhāriya parivēsa vaṭṭaṇa vārēi suō karē dhettuṁ // PiṇḍNi.215
avikālakarahīkhīraṁ lhasuṇa palaṇḍū surā ya gōmaṁsaṁ
vēyasamaēvi abhayaṁ kiñci abhojjaṁ apejjaṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.216
vannāijuyāvi balī sapalalaphalasēharā asuinatthā
asuissa vippusēṇavi jaha chikkāō abhojjāō // PiṇḍNi.217
ēmēva ujjhiyammivi āhākammammi akayaē kappē
hōi abhojjaṁ bhāṇē jattha vasuddhampi taṁ paḍiyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.218
vantuccārasaricchaṁ kammaṁ sōumavi kōviō bhīō
pariharai sāvi ya duhā vihiavihīē ya pariharaṇā ।। gāhā-220 // PiṇḍNi.219
sālīōaṇahatthaṁ daṭṭhuṁ bhaṇai avikōviō dentiṁ
kattoccautti sālī? vaṇi jāṇai puccha taṁ gantuṁ // PiṇḍNi.220
gantūṇa āvaṇaṁ sō vāṇiyagaṁ pucchaē kaō sālī
paccantē magahāē gobbaragāmō tahiṁ vayai // PiṇḍNi.221
kammāsaṅkāē pahaṁ mottuṁ kaṇṭāhisāvayā adisi
chāyampi vivajjantō ḍajjhai uṇhēṇa mucchāī // PiṇḍNi.222
iya avihīparihārī nāṇāīṇaṁ na hōi ābhāgī
davvakuladēsabhāvē vihipariharaṇā imā tattha // PiṇḍNi.223
ōyaṇasamiimasattuga kummāsāī u honti davvāiṁ
bahujanamappajanaṁ vā kulaṁ tu dēsō suraṭṭhāī // PiṇḍNi.224
āyara'nāyara bhāvē sayaṁ va annēṇa vā'vi dāvaṇayā
ēēsiṁ tu payāṇaṁ caupaya tipayā va bhayaṇā u // PiṇḍNi.225
anuciyadēsaṁ savvaṁ kulamappaṁ āyarō ya tō pucchā
bahuēvi natthi pucchā sadēsadaviē abhāvē'vi // PiṇḍNi.226
tujjhaṭṭhāē kayamiṇamannonnamavekkhaē ya savilakkhaṁ
vajjanti gāḍharuṭṭhā kā bhē tattitti vā giṇhē // PiṇḍNi.227
gūḍhāyārā na karenti āyaraṁ pucchiyāvi na kahenti

āhākammapariṇaō phāsuyabhōīvi bandhaō hōi

saṅghuddiṭṭhaṁ sōuṁ ēi duyaṁ kōi bhōiē pattō

māsiyapāraṇagaṭṭhā gamanaṁ āsannagāmagaṁ khamagē

khellagamallagalecchāriyāṇi ḍimbhaga nibhaccha ruṇṭaṇayā

ēgantamavakkamaṇaṁ jai sāhū ijja hojja tinnō mi
taṇukoṭṭhammi amucchā bhuttammi ya kēvalaṁ nāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.233
candōdayaṁ ca sūrōdayaṁ ca rannō u donni ujjāṇā
tēsiṁ vivariyagamanē āṇākōvō taō daṇḍō // PiṇḍNi.234
sūrōdayaṁ gacchamahaṁ pabhāē candōdayaṁ jantu taṇāihārā
duhā khī paccurasantikāuṁ rāyāvi candōdayamēva gacchē // PiṇḍNi.235
pattaladumasālagayā dacchāmu nivaṅgaṇatti duccittā
ujjānapālaēhiṁ gahiyā ya hayā ya baddhā ya ।। gāhā-237 // PiṇḍNi.236
sahasa paiṭṭhā diṭṭha iyarēhi nivaṅgaṇatti tō baddhā

jaha tē daṁsaṇakaṅkhī apūriicchā vināsiyā raṇṇā

āhākamma bhuñjai na paḍikkamaē ya tassa ṭhāṇassa

āhākammaddāraṁ bhaṇiyamiyāṇiṁ purā samuddiṭṭhaṁ

ōhēṇa vibhāgēṇa ya ōhē ṭhappaṁ tu bārasa vibhāgē

jīvāmu kahavi ōmē niyayaṁ bhikkhāvi kaivaī dēmō

sā u avisēsiyaṁ ciya miyammi bhattammi taṇḍulē chuhai

chaumatthōdhuddēsaṁ kahaṁ viyāṇāi? cōiē bhaṇai
uvauttō guru ēvaṁ gihatthasaddāiciṭṭhāē // PiṇḍNi.244
dinnā u tāu pañcavi rēhāu karēi dēi va gaṇanti
dēha iō mā ya iō avaṇēha ya ettiyā bhikkhā // PiṇḍNi.245
saddāiēsu sāhū mucchaṁ na karejja gōyaragaō ya
ēsaṇajuttō hojjā gōṇīvacchō gavattivva // PiṇḍNi.246
ūsavamaṇḍaṇavaggā na pāṇiyaṁ vacchaē naviya cāriṁ

pañcavihavisayasokkhakkhaṇī vahū samahiyaṁ gihaṁ taṁ tu
na gaṇēi gōṇivacchō mucchiya gaḍhiō gavattammi // PiṇḍNi.248
gamanāgamanukkhēvē bhāsiya sōyāi indiyāuttō
ēsaṇamanēsaṇaṁ vā taha jāṇai tammaṇō samaṇō // PiṇḍNi.249
mahaīē saṅkhaḍīē uvvariyaṁ kūravañjaṇāīyaṁ
pauraṁ daṭṭhūṇa gihī bhaṇai imaṁ dēhi puṇṇaṭṭhā // PiṇḍNi.250
tattha vibhāguddēsiyamēvaṁ sambhavai puvvamuddiṭṭhaṁ
sīsagaṇahiyaṭṭhāē taṁ cēva vibhāgaō bhaṇai // PiṇḍNi.251
uddēsiyaṁ samuddēsiyaṁ ca āēsiyaṁ samāēsaṁ
ēvaṁ kaḍē ya kammē ekkekki caukkaō bhēō // PiṇḍNi.252
jāvantiyamuddēsaṁ pāsaṇḍīṇaṁ bhavē samuddēsaṁ
samaṇāṇaṁ āēsaṁ nigganthāṇaṁ samāēsaṁ ।। gāhā-254 // PiṇḍNi.253
chinnamachinnaṁ duvihaṁ davvē khettē ya kāla bhāvē ya
nipphāiyanipphannaṁ nāyavvaṁ jaṁ jahiṁ kamai // PiṇḍNi.254
bhattuvvariyaṁ khalu saṅkhaḍīē taddivasamannadivasē vā
antō bahiṁ ca savvaṁ savvadinaṁ dēhiṁ acchinnaṁ // PiṇḍNi.255
dēhi imaṁ mā sēsaṁ antō bāhiragayaṁ va ēgayaraṁ
jāva amugatti vēlā amugaṁ vēlaṁ ca ārabbha // PiṇḍNi.256
davvāī chinnampi hu jai bhaṇaī āraō'vi mā dēha
tō kappai chinnampi hu acchinnakaḍaṁ pariharanti // PiṇḍNi.257
amugāṇanti va dijjau amukāṇaṁ matti ettha u vibhāsā
jattha jaīṇa visiṭṭhō niddēsō taṁ pariharijjā // PiṇḍNi.258
sandissantaṁ jō suṇai kappaē tassa sēsaē ṭhavaṇā
saṅkaliya sāhaṇaṁ vā karenti asuē imā mērā // PiṇḍNi.259
mā ēyaṁ dēhi imaṁ puṭṭhē siṭṭhammi taṁ pariharanti
jaṁ dinnaṁ taṁ dinnaṁ mā sampai dēhi gēṇhanti // PiṇḍNi.260
rasabhāyaṇahēuṁ vā mā kucchihiī suhaṁ va dāhāmi

mā kāhanti avaṇṇaṁ parikaṭṭhaliyaṁ va dijjai suhaṁ tu

ēmēva ya kammammi'vi uṇhavaṇē navari tattha nāṇattaṁ

amuganti puṇō raddhaṁ dāhamakappaṁ tu āraō kappaṁ

jaṁ jaha va kayaṁ dāhaṁ taṁ kappai āraō tahā akayaṁ

chakkāyaniranukampā jinapavayaṇabāhirā bahipphōḍā
ēvaṁ vayanti phōḍā lukkavilukkā jaha kavōḍā // PiṇḍNi.266
pūīkammaṁ duvihaṁ davvē bhāvē ya hōi nāyavvaṁ

gandhāiguṇasamiḍhaṁ jaṁ davvaṁ asuigandhadavvajuyaṁ
pūitti pariharijjai taṁ jāṇasu davvapūitti // PiṇḍNi.268
goṭṭhiniuttō dhammī sahāē āsannagoṭṭhibhattāē
samiyasuravallamīsaṁ ajinna sannā mahisipōhō // PiṇḍNi.269
sañjāyalittabhattē goṭṭhigagandhotti cullavaṇiāyō
ukkhaṇiya annachagaṇēṇa limpaṇaṁ davvapūī ū ।। gāhā-271 // PiṇḍNi.270
uggamakōḍīavayavamittēṇa vi mīsiyaṁ susuddhampi
suddhampi kuṇai caraṇaṁ pūiṁ taṁ bhāvaō pūī // PiṇḍNi.271
āhākammuddēsiya mīsaṁ taha bāyarā ya pāhuḍiyā
pūī ajjhōyaraō uggamakōḍī bhavē ēsā // PiṇḍNi.272
bāyara suhumaṁ bhāvē u pūiyaṁ suhumamuvari vocchāmi
uvagaraṇa bhattapāṇē duvihaṁ puṇa bāyaraṁ pūiṁ // PiṇḍNi.273
cullukkhaliyā ḍōē davvīchūḍhē ya mīsagaṁ pūiṁ
ḍāē lōṇē hiṅgū saṅkāmaṇa phōḍaṇē dhūmē // PiṇḍNi.274
sijjhantassuvayāraṁ dijjantassa va karēi jaṁ davvaṁ
taṁ uvakaraṇaṁ cullī ukkhā davvī ya ḍōyāī // PiṇḍNi.275
culukkhā kammāī āimabhaṅgēsu tīsuvi akappaṁ
paḍikuṭṭhaṁ tatthatthaṁ annatthagayaṁ aṇunnāyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.276
kammiyakaddamamissā cullī ukkhā ya phaḍḍagajuyā u
uvagaraṇapūimēyaṁ ḍōē daṇḍē va ēgayarē // PiṇḍNi.277
davvīchūḍhetti jaṁ vuttaṁ kammadavvīē jaṁ daē
kammaṁ ghaṭṭiya suddhaṁ tu ghaṭṭaē hārapūiyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.278
attaṭṭhiya āyāṇē ḍāyaṁ lōṇaṁ ca kamma hiṅguṁ vā
taṁ bhattapāṇapūī phōḍaṇa annaṁ va jaṁ chuhai // PiṇḍNi.279
saṅkāmēuṁ kammaṁ siddhaṁ jaṅkiñci tattha chūḍhaṁ vā
aṅgāradhūmi thālī vēsaṇa heṭṭhā muṇīhi dhūmō // PiṇḍNi.280
indhaṇadhūmēgandhē avayavamāīhiṁ suhumapūī u
sundaramēyaṁ pūī cōyaga bhaṇiē gurū bhaṇai // PiṇḍNi.281
indhaṇadhūmēgandhē avayavamāī na pūiyaṁ hōi
jēsiṁ tu ēsa pūī sōhī navi vijjaē tēsiṁ // PiṇḍNi.282
indhaṇa agaṇīavayava dhūmō bapphō ya annagandhō ya
savvaṁ phusanti lōyaṁ bhannai savvaṁ taō pūī // PiṇḍNi.283
nanu suhumapūiyassā puvvuddiṭṭhassa'sambhavō ēvaṁ
indhaṇadhūmāīhiṁ tamhā pūitti siddhamiṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.284
cōyaga! indhaṇamāīhiṁ cauhivi suhumapūiyaṁ hōi
pannavaṇāmittamiyaṁ pariharaṇā natthi ēyassa // PiṇḍNi.285
sajjhamasajjhaṁ kajjaṁ sajjhaṁ sāhijjaē na u asajjhaṁ
jō u asajjhaṁ sāhai kilissai na taṁ ca sāhēī // PiṇḍNi.286
āhākammiyabhāyaṇa papphōḍaṇa kāu akayaē kappē
gahiyaṁ tu suhumapūī dhōvaṇamāīhiṁ pariharaṇā ।। gāhā-288 // PiṇḍNi.287
dhōyampi nirāvayavaṁ na hōi āhacca kammagahaṇammi
na ya addavvā u guṇā bhannaī suddhā kaō ēvaṁ? // PiṇḍNi.288
lōēvi asuigandhā vipariṇayā dūraō na dūsanti
na ya māranti pariṇayā dūragāya avi visāvayavā // PiṇḍNi.289
sēsēhi u davvēhiṁ jāvaiyaṁ phusai tattiyaṁ pūī
lēvēhi tihi u pūī kappai kappē kaē tiguṇē // PiṇḍNi.290
indhaṇamāiṁ mottuṁ caurō sēsāṇi honti davvāiṁ
tēsiṁ puṇa parimāṇaṁ tayappamāṇāu ārabbha // PiṇḍNi.291
paḍhamadivasammi kammaṁ tinni u divasāṇi pūiyaṁ hōi
pūīsu tisu na kappai kappai taiō jayā kappō // PiṇḍNi.292
samaṇakaḍāhākammaṁ samaṇāṇaṁ jaṁ kaḍēṇa mīsaṁ tu

saḍḍhassa thēvadivasēsu saṅkhaḍī āsi saṅghabhattaṁ vā

mīsajjāyaṁ jāvantiyaṁ ca pāsaṇḍisāhumīsaṁ ca
sahasantaraṁ na kappai kappai kappē kaē tiguṇē // PiṇḍNi.295
duggāsē taṁ samaicchiuṁ va addhāṇasīsaē jattā
saḍḍhī bahubhikkhayarē mīsajjāyaṁ karē kōī // PiṇḍNi.296
jāvantaṭṭhā siddhaṁ na ēi taṁ dēha kāmiyaṁ jaiṇaṁ
bahusu va apahuppantē bhaṇāi annampi randhēha // PiṇḍNi.297
attaṭṭhā randhantē pāsaṇḍīṇampi biiyaō bhaṇai
nigganthaṭṭhā taiō attaṭṭhāē'vi randhantē sō hōi // PiṇḍNi.298
visaghāiyapisiyāsī marai tamannōvi khāiuṁ marai
iya pāramparamaraṇē anumarai sahassasō jāva // PiṇḍNi.299
ēvaṁ mīsajjāyaṁ caraṇappaṁ haṇai sāhu suvisuddhaṁ
tamhā taṁ nō kappai purisasahassantaragayampi // PiṇḍNi.300
nicchōḍiē karīsēṇa vā'vi uvvaṭṭiē taō kappā
sukkhāvittā giṇhai anna cautthē asukkē'vi // PiṇḍNi.301
saṭṭhāṇaparaṭṭhāṇē duvihaṁ ṭhaviyaṁ tu hōi nāyavvaṁ
khīrāi paramparaē hatthagaya gharantaraṁ jāva // PiṇḍNi.302
cullī uvacullī vā ṭhāṇasaṭhāṇaṁ tu bhāyaṇaṁ piḍharē
saṭṭhāṇaṭṭhāṇammi ya bhāyaṇaṭṭhāṇē ya caubhaṅgō // PiṇḍNi.303
chabbagavāragamāī hōi paraṭṭhāṇamō va'nēgavihaṁ
saṭṭhāṇē piḍharē chabbagē ya ēmēva dūrē ya ।। gāhā-305 // PiṇḍNi.304
ekkekkaṁ taṁ duvihaṁ anantaraṁ paramparē ya nāyavvaṁ
avikāri kayaṁ davvaṁ taṁ cēva anantaraṁ hōi // PiṇḍNi.305
ucchukkhīrāīyaṁ vigāri avigāri ghayagulāīyaṁ
pariyāvajjaṇadōsā ōyaṇadahimāīyaṁ vā'vi // PiṇḍNi.306
ubbhaṭṭha parinnāyaṁ annaṁ laddhaṁ paōyaṇē ghecchī
riṇabhīyā va agārī dahitti dāhaṁ suē ṭhavaṇā // PiṇḍNi.307
navanīya manthutakkaṁ va jāva attaṭṭhiyā va giṇhanti
dēsūṇā jāva ghayaṁ kusaṇampiya jattiyaṁ kālaṁ // PiṇḍNi.308
rasakakkabapiṇḍagulā macchaṇḍiya khaṇḍa sakkarāṇaṁ ca
hōi paramparaṭhavaṇā annattha va jujjaē jattha // PiṇḍNi.309
bhikkhaggāhī ēgattha kuṇai biiō u dōsu uvaōgaṁ
tēna paraṁ ukkhittā pāhuḍiyā hōi ṭhavaṇā u // PiṇḍNi.310
pāhuḍiyāvi hu duvihā bāyara suhumā ya hōi nāyavvā
ōsakkaṇamussakkaṇa kabbaṭṭhīē samōsaraṇō // PiṇḍNi.311
kantāmi tāva pēluṁ tō tē dāhāmi putta! mā rōva
taṁ jai suṇēi sāhū na gacchaē tattha ārambhō // PiṇḍNi.312
annaṭṭha uṭṭhiyā bā tubbhavi dāhāmi kimpi pariharati
kiha dāṇi na uṭṭhihisī? sāhupabhāvēṇa labbhāmō // PiṇḍNi.313
mā tāva jhaṅkha puttaya! parivāḍīē ihēhi sō sāhū
ēyassa uṭṭhiyā tē dāhaṁ sōuṁ vivajjēi // PiṇḍNi.314
aṅguliyāē ghettuṁ kaḍḍhai kappaṭṭhaō gharaṁ tēṇaṁ
kinti kahiē na gacchai pāhuḍiyā ēsa suhumā u // PiṇḍNi.315
puttassa vivāhadiṇaṁ ōsaraṇē aicchiē muṇiya saḍḍhā
ōsakkantō saraṇē saṅkhaḍipāhēṇaga davaṭṭhā // PiṇḍNi.316
appattammi ya ṭhaviyaṁ ōsaraṇē hōhiitti ussakaṇaṁ
taṁ pāgaḍamiyaraṁ vā karēi ujjū anujjū vā // PiṇḍNi.317
maṅgalahēuṁ punnaṭṭhayā va ōsakkiyaṁ duhā pagayaṁ
ussakkiyampi kinti ya puṭṭhē siṭṭhē vivajjanti // PiṇḍNi.318
pāhuḍibhattaṁ bhuñjaiṁ na paḍikkamaē ya tassa ṭhāṇassa
ēmēva aḍai bōḍō lukkavilukkō jaha kavōḍō // PiṇḍNi.319
lōyaviraluttamaṅgaṁ tavōkisaṁ jallakhauriyasarīraṁ
jugamettantaradiṭṭhiṁ aturiyacavalaṁ sagihamintaṁ // PiṇḍNi.320
daṭṭhūṇa ya tamanagāraṁ saḍḍhī saṁvēgamāgayā kāī
vipula'nnapāṇa ghettūṇa niggayā niggaō sō'vi ।। gāhā-322 // PiṇḍNi.321
nīyaduvārammi gharē na sujjhaī ēsaṇattikāūṇaṁ
nīhammiē agārī acchai viliyā va'gahiēṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.322
caraṇakaraṇālasaṁmī annammi ya āgaē gahiya pucchā
ihalōgaṁ paralōgaṁ kahēi caiuṁ imaṁ lōgaṁ // PiṇḍNi.323
nīyaduvārammi gharē bhikkhaṁ nicchanti ēsaṇāsamiyā
jaṁ pucchasi majjha kahaṁ kappai? liṅgōvajīvī'haṁ // PiṇḍNi.324
sāhuguṇēsaṇakahaṇaṁ āuṭṭā tassa tippai tahēva
kukkuḍi caranti ēē vayaṁ tu cinnavvayā bīō // PiṇḍNi.325
pāōkaraṇaṁ duvihaṁ pāgaḍakaraṇaṁ pagāsakaraṇaṁ ca
pāgaḍa saṅkāmaṇa kuḍḍadārapāē ya chinnē va // PiṇḍNi.326
rayaṇapaīvē jōī na kappai pagāsaṇā suvihiyāṇaṁ
attaṭṭhiya paribhottuṁ kappai kappē akāūṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.327
sañcārimā ya cullī bahiṁ va cullī purā kayā tēsiṁ
tahi randhanti kayāī uvahī pūī ya pāō ya // PiṇḍNi.328
necchaha tamisammi taō bāhiracullīē sāhu siddhaṇṇē
iya sōuṁ pariharaē puṭṭhē siṭṭhammivi tahēva // PiṇḍNi.329
macchiyadhammā antō bāhi pavāyaṁ pagāsamāsannaṁ
iya attaṭṭhiya gahaṇaṁ pāgaḍakaraṇē vibhāsā u // PiṇḍNi.330
kuḍḍassa kuṇai chiḍḍaṁ dāraṁ vaḍḍhēi kuṇai annaṁ vā
avaṇēi chāyaṇaṁ vā ṭhāvai rayaṇaṁ va dippantaṁ // PiṇḍNi.331
jōi paivaṁ kuṇai va tahēva kahaṇaṁ tu puṭṭhē'puṭṭhēvā
attaṭṭhiē u gahaṇaṁ jōi paīvē u vajjēi // PiṇḍNi.332
pāgaḍapayāsakaraṇē kayammi sahasā va ahava'nābhōgā
gahiyaṁ vigiñciūṇaṁ gēṇhai annaṁ akayakappē // PiṇḍNi.333
kīyagaḍampiya duvihaṁ davvē bhāvē ya duvihamekkekkaṁ
āyakiyaṁ ca parakiyaṁ paradavvaṁ tiviha'cittāi // PiṇḍNi.334
āyakiyaṁ puṇa duvihaṁ davvē bhāvē ya davva cuṇṇāī
bhāvammi parassa'ṭṭhā ahavāvī appaṇā cēva // PiṇḍNi.335
nimmallagandhaguliyā vannayapottāi āyakaya davvē
gēlannē uḍḍāhō pauṇē caḍugāri ahigaraṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.336
vaiyāi maṅkhamāī parabhāvakayaṁ tu sañjayaṭṭhāē
uppāyaṇā nimantaṇa kīḍagaḍa abhihaḍē ṭhaviē // PiṇḍNi.337
sāgāri maṅkha chandaṇa paḍisēhō puccha bahu gaē vāsē
kayariṁ disiṁ gamissaha? amuiṁ tahiṁ santhavaṁ kuṇai ।। gāhā-339 // PiṇḍNi.338
dijjantē paḍisēhō kajjē ghecchaṁ nimantaṇaṁ jaiṇaṁ

dhammakaha vāya khamaṇaṁ nimitta āyāvaṇē suyaṭṭhāṇaṁ

kaḍḍhaṁ ti sāhavō ciya tumaṁ va kahi ? pucchiē tusiṇī // PiṇḍNi.341

ēmēva vāi khamaē nimittamāyāvagammi ya vibhāsā

pāmiccampiya duvihaṁ lōiya lōguttaraṁ samāsēṇa

suyaabhigamanāya vihī bahi pucchā ēga jīvai sasā tē
pavisaṇa pāga nivāraṇa ucchindaṇa tella jaidāṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.345
aparimiyanēhavuḍḍhī dāsattaṁ sō ya āgaō pucchā

bhikkha dagasamārambhē kahaṇāuṭṭō kahiṁ ti vasahitti

ēē cēva ya dōsā savisēsayarā u vatthapāēsuṁ
lōiyapāmiccēsuṁ lōguttariyā imē annē // PiṇḍNi.348
mailiya phāliya khōmiya hiya naṭṭhē vā'vi anna maggantē
avi sundarē vi dinnē dukkararōī kalahamāī // PiṇḍNi.349
uccattāē dānaṁ dullabha khaggūḍa alasa pāmiccē

pariyaṭṭiyampi duvihaṁ lōiya lōguttaraṁ samāsēṇaṁ
ekkekkampiya duvihaṁ taddavvē annadavvē ya // PiṇḍNi.351
avaroppasajjhilagā sañjuttā dōvi annamannēṇaṁ

anukampa bhaginigēhē daridda pariyaṭṭaṇā ya kūrassa

iyarō'viya pantāvē nisi ōsaviyāṇa tēsi dikkhā ya
tamhā u na ghētavvaṁ kai vā jē ōsamēhinti ? // PiṇḍNi.354
ūṇahiya dubbalaṁ vā khara guru chinnaṁ maila asīyasahaṁ

ēgassa māṇajuttaṁ na u biiē ēvamāikajjēsu

āinnamaṇāinnaṁ nisihābhihaḍaṁ ca nōnisīhaṁ ca

saggāma paraggāmē sadēsa paradēsamēva boddhavvaṁ

sañjamaāyavirāhaṇa tahiyaṁ puṇa sañjamē kāyā // PiṇḍNi.359
atthāhagāhapaṁ kāmagarōhārā jalē avāyā u
kaṇṭāhitēṇasāvaya thalambhi ēē bhavē dōsā // PiṇḍNi.360
saggāmē'viya duvihaṁ gharantaraṁ nōgharantaraṁ cēva

sunnaṁ va asai kālō pagayaṁ va pahēṇagaṁ va pāsuttā

ēsēva kamō niyamā nisihābhihaḍē'vi hōi nāyavvō

aidūrajalantariyā kammāsaṅkāē mā na ghecchanti

niggama dēula dānaṁ diyāi sannāi niggaē dānaṁ

bhuñjaṇa ajīra purimaḍḍhagāi acchanti bhuttasēsaṁ vā

ukkhittaṁ nikkhippai āsagayaṁ mallagammi pāsagaē
khāmittu gayā saḍḍhā tē'vi ya suddhā asaḍhabhāvā // PiṇḍNi.368
laddhaṁ pahēṇagaṁ mē amugatthagayāē saṅkhaḍīē vā

ēyaṁ tu aṇāinnaṁ duvihampiya āhaḍaṁ samakkhāyaṁ

āiṇṇaṁ mivi tigihā taṁ ciya uvaōgapuvvāgā ।। gāhā-373 // PiṇḍNi.372
parivēsaṇapantīē dūrapavēsē ya ghaṅghasālagihē

hōi puṇa dēsadēsō antō giha sā na dīsaē jattha
ukkhēvāī tattha u sōyāī dēi uvaōgaṁ // PiṇḍNi.374

pihiubbhinnakavāḍē phāsuya apphāsē ya boddhavē

ubbhinnē chakkāyā dānē kayavikkaē ya ahigaraṇaṁ

saccittapuḍhavilittaṁ lēlu silaṁ vā'vi dāumōlittaṁ

ēvaṁ tu puvva nō littē kāyā ullimpaṇē'vi tē cēva

parassa taṁ dēi saē va gēhē tellaṁ va lōṇaṁ va ghayaṁ gulaṁ vā

dānakayavikkayā cēva hōi ahigaraṇamajayabhāvassa

jahēva kumbhāisu puvvalittē ubbhijjamāṇē ya havanti kāyā

gharakōilasañcārā āvattaṇa pīḍhagāi heṭṭhuvariṁ

gheppai aṅkuciyāgammi kavāḍē paidinē parivahantē

mālōhaḍampi duvihaṁ jahannamukkōsagaṁ ca boddhavvaṁ

bhikkhū jahannagaṁmī gēruya ukkōsagammi diṭṭhantō
ahiḍasaṇamālapaḍaṇē ya ēvamāī bhavē dōsā // PiṇḍNi.387
mālābhimuhaṁ daṭṭhūṇa agāriṁ niggaō taō sāhū

mālammi kuṭṭha mōyaga sugandha ahi pavisaṇaṁ karē ḍakkā

āsandipīḍhamañcakajaṁ tōḍūkhala paḍanta ubhayavahē

ēmēva ya ukkōsē vāraṇa nissēṇi guvviṇīpaḍaṇaṁ
gabbhitthikucchiphōḍaṇa puraō maraṇaṁ kahaṇa bōhī // PiṇḍNi.391

daddarasilasōvāṇē puvvārūḍhē anuccamukkhittē

gōvālaē ya bhayaē kharaē puttē ya dhūya suṇhāē

nānivviṭṭhaṁ labbhai dāsī vi na bhujjaē ritē bhattā

āhārōvahimāī jai aṭṭhāē u kōi acchindē
saṅkhaḍi asaṅkhaḍīē taṁ giṇhantē imē dōsā // PiṇḍNi.401
aciyattamantarāyaṁ tēnāhaḍa ēga'nēgavocchēō
nicchubhaṇāī dōsā tassa a lambhē ya jaṁ pāvē // PiṇḍNi.402

vocchēya paōsaṁ vā na kappaī kappa'ṇunnāyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.403
sañjayabhaddā tēṇā āyantī vā asantharē jaiṇaṁ
jai dētiṁ na ghettavvaṁ nicchubha vocchēu mā hojjā // PiṇḍNi.404
ghayasattuyadiṭṭhantō samaṇunnāya va ghettuṇaṁ pacchā

aviya hu battīsāē dinnēhiṁ tavēga mōyagō na bhavē
appavayaṁ bahuāyaṁ jai jāṇasi dēhi tō majjhaṁ // PiṇḍNi.409

giṇhaṇa kaḍḍhaṇa vavahāra pacchakaḍuḍḍāha puccha nivvisaē
apahummi hunti dōsā pahummi dinnē taō gahaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.411
ēmēva ya jantammivi saṅkhaḍi khīrē ya āvaṇāīsuṁ
sāmannaṁ paḍikuṭṭhaṁ kappai ghettuṁ aṇunnāyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.412
cullatti dāramahuṇā bahuvattavvanti taṁ kayaṁ pacchā

chinnamachinnō duvihō hōi achinnō nisiṭṭha anisiṭṭhō

nivapiṇḍō gayabhattaṁ gahaṇāī antarāiyamadinnaṁ
ḍombassa santiēvi hu abhikkha vasahīya phēḍaṇayā // PiṇḍNi.417
ajjhōyaraō tivihō jāvantiya sadharamīsapāsaṇḍē

taṇḍulajalaāyāṇē pupphaphalē sāgavēsaṇē lōṇē
parimāṇē nāṇattaṁ ajjhōyaramīsajāē ya // PiṇḍNi.419
jāvantiē visōhī sagharapāsaṇḍimīsaē pūī
chinnē visōhi dinnammi kappaī na kappaī sēsaṁ // PiṇḍNi.420
chinnammi taō ukkaḍḍhiyammi kappai pihīkaē sēsaṁ
āhāvaṇāē dinnaṁ ca tattiyaṁ kappaē sēsaṁ // PiṇḍNi.421
ēsō sōlasabhēō duhā kīraī uggamō
ēgō visōhikōḍī avisōhī u cāvarā // PiṇḍNi.422

bāyarapāhuḍiyāviya ajjhōyaraē ya carimadugaṁ ।। gāhā-424 // PiṇḍNi.423
uggamakōḍī avayava lēvālēvē ya akayaē kappē
kañjiya āyāmaga cāulōya saṁsaṭṭha pūīō // PiṇḍNi.424
sukkēṇa'vi jaṁ chikkaṁ tu asuiṇā dhōvaē jahā lōē
iha sukkēṇa'vi chikkaṁ dōvai kammēṇa bhāṇaṁ tu? // PiṇḍNi.425
lēvālēvatti jaṁ vuttaṁ jampi davvamalēvaḍaṁ
tampi ghettuṁ na kappanti takkāi kimu lēvaḍaṁ? // PiṇḍNi.426

sēsā visōhikōḍī bhattaṁ pānaṁ vigiñca jahasattiṁ
aṇalakkhiya mīsadavē savvavivēgē'vayava suddhō // PiṇḍNi.428
davvāiō vivēgō davvē jaṁ davva jaṁ jahiṁ khettē

sukkollasarisapāē asarisapāē ya ettha caubhaṅgō

sukkē sukkaṁ paḍiyaṁ vigiñciuṁ hōi taṁ suhaṁ paḍhamō

taiyammi karaṁ chōḍhuṁ ulliñcai ōyaṇāi jaṁ tarau
dullahadavvaṁ carimē tattiyamittaṁ vigiñcanti // PiṇḍNi.432
santharē savvamujjhanti caubhaṅgō asantharē
asaḍhō sujjhaī tēsuṁ māyāvī jēsu bajjhaī // PiṇḍNi.433
kōḍīkaraṇaṁ duvihaṁ uggamakōḍī visōhikōḍī ya
uggamakōḍī chakkaṁ visōhikōḍī anēgavihā // PiṇḍNi.434
nava cēva aḍhārasagaṁ sattāvīsā tahēva caupannā

sōlasa uggamadōsē gihiṇōu samuṭṭhiē viyāṇāhi

nāmaṁ ṭhavaṇā daviē bhāvē uppāyaṇā muṇēyavvā
davvammi hōi tivihā bhāvammi u sōlasapayā u // PiṇḍNi.437
āsūyamāiēhiṁ bālaciyaturaṅga bīyamāīhiṁ
suyaāsadumāīṇaṁ uppāyaṇayā u saccittā // PiṇḍNi.438
kanagarayayāiyāṇaṁ jaheṭṭhadhāuvihiyā u accittā

bhāvē pasattha iyarō kōhāuppāyaṇā u apasatthō

dhāī dūi nimittē ājīva vaṇīmagē tigicchā ya

puvvimpacchāsanthava vijjā bhantē ya cuṇṇa jōgē ya
uppāyaṇāi dōsā sōlasamē mūlakammē ya // PiṇḍNi.442
khīrē ya majjaṇē maṇḍaṇē ya kīlāvaṇaṅkadhāī ya
ekkekkāviya duvihā karaṇē kārāvaṇē cēva // PiṇḍNi.443
dhārēi dhīyaē vā dhayanti vā tamiti tēṇa dhāī u
jahavihavaṁ āsi purā khīrāī pañca dhāīō // PiṇḍNi.444
khīrāhārō rōvai majjha kayāsāya dēhi ṇaṁ pijjē
pacchā va majjha dāhisi alaṁ va bhujjō va ēhāmi // PiṇḍNi.445
maimaṁ arōgi dīhāuō ya hōi avimāṇiō bālō
dullabhayaṁ khu suyamuhaṁ pijjāhi ahaṁ va sē dēmi // PiṇḍNi.446
ahigaraṇa bhaddapantā kammudaya gilāṇaē ya uḍḍāhō

ayamavarō u vikappō bhikkhāyari saḍḍhi addhiī pucchā

vayagaṇḍataṇuyathūlattaṇēhiṁ taṁ pucchiuṁ ayāṇantō
tattha gaō tassamakkhaṁ bhaṇāi taṁ pāsiuṁ bālaṁ // PiṇḍNi.449
ahuṇuṭṭhiyaṁ va aṇavikkhiyaṁ va iṇamaṁ kulaṁ tu mannāmi

jaṁ saṅkiyamāvannō paṇavīsā carimaē suddhō // PiṇḍNi.563
uggamadōsā sōlasa āhākammāi ēsaṇādōsā
nava makkhiyāi ēē paṇavīsā carimaē suddhō // PiṇḍNi.564
chaumatthō suyanāṇī uvauttō ujjuō payattēṇaṁ
āvannō paṇavīsaṁ suyanāṇapamāṇaō suddhō // PiṇḍNi.565
ōhō suōvauttō suyanāṇī jai vi giṇhai asuddhaṁ
taṁ kēvalī vi bhuñjai appamāṇa suyaṁ bhavē iharā // PiṇḍNi.566
suttassa appamāṇē caraṇābhāvō taō ya mokkhassa
mokkhassa'viya abhāvē dikkhapavittī niratthā u // PiṇḍNi.567
kintiha khaddha ! bhikkhā dijjai na ya tarai pucchiuṁ hirimaṁ
iya saṅkāē dhettuṁ taṁ bhuñjai saṅkiō cēva // PiṇḍNi.568
hiyaēṇa saṅkaēṇaṁ gahiō annēṇaṁ sōhiyā sā ya
pagayaṁ pahēṇagaṁ vā sōuṁ nissaṅkiō bhuñjē // PiṇḍNi.569
jārisaya cciya laddhā khaddhā bhikkhā maē amuyagēhē
annēhi vi tārisiyā viyaḍanta nisāmaē taiē // PiṇḍNi.570
jai saṅkā dōsakarī ēvaṁ suddhampi hōi avisuddhaṁ
nissaṅkamēsiyantiya anēsaṇijjampi niddōsaṁ // PiṇḍNi.571
avisuddhō pariṇāmō ēgayarē avaḍiō ya pakkhammi
ēsimpi kuṇai ṇēsiṁ aṇēsimēsiṁ visuddhō u // PiṇḍNi.572
duvihaṁ ca makkhiyaṁ khalu saccittaṁ cēva hōi accittaṁ
saccittaṁ puṇa tivihaṁ accittaṁ hōi duvihaṁ tu // PiṇḍNi.573
puḍhavī āu vaṇassai tivihaṁ saccittamakkhiyaṁ hōi
accittaṁ puṇa duvihaṁ garahiyamiyarē ya bhayaṇā u // PiṇḍNi.574
sukkēṇa sarakkhēṇa makkhiyamallēṇa puḍhavikāēṇaṁ
savvampi makkhiyaṁ taṁ ettō āummi vocchāmi // PiṇḍNi.575
purapacchakamma sasiṇiddhullē cattāri āubhēyāō
ukkiṭṭharasālittaṁ paritta'nantaṁ mahiruhēsu ।। gāhā-577 // PiṇḍNi.576
sēsēhi u kāēhiṁ tīhi vi tēūsamīraṇatasēhiṁ
saccittaṁ mīsaṁ vā na makkhitaṁ atthi ullaṁ vā // PiṇḍNi.577
saccittamakkhiyammi u hatthē mattē ya hōi caubhaṅgō
āitiē paḍisēhō carimē bhaṅgē aṇunnā u // PiṇḍNi.578
accittamakkhiyammi u causu vi bhaṅgēsu hōi bhayaṇā u
agarahiēṇa u gahaṇaṁ paḍisēhō garahiē hōi // PiṇḍNi.579
saṁsajjimēhiṁ vajjaṁ agarahiēhimpi gōrasadavēhiṁ
mahughayatella gulēhi ya mā macchipivīliyāghāō // PiṇḍNi.580
maṁsavasasōṇiyāsava lōē vā garahiēhiṁ vivajjejjā
ubhaō'vi garahiēhiṁ muttuccārēhiṁ chittampi // PiṇḍNi.581
saccittamīsaēsu duvihaṁ kāēsu hōi nikkhittaṁ
ekkekkaṁ taṁ duvihaṁ anantara paramparaṁ cēva // PiṇḍNi.582
puḍhavī āukkāē tēu vāū vaṇassai tasāṇaṁ
ekkekka duhā'nantara parampara'gaṇimmi sattavihā // PiṇḍNi.583
saccittapuḍhavikāē saccittō cēva puḍhavi nikkhittō
āū tēu vaṇassai samīraṇa tasēsu ēmēva // PiṇḍNi.584
ēmēva sēsayāṇavi nikkhēvō hōi jīvakāyakāēsuṁ
ekkekkō saṭṭhāṇē paraṭhāṇē pañca pañcēva // PiṇḍNi.585
ēmēva mīsaēsu vi mīsāṇa sacēyaṇāṇa nikkhēvō
mīsāṇaṁ mīsēsu ya dōṇhampiya hōi accittē // PiṇḍNi.586
jattha u sacittamīsē caubhaṅgō tattha caūsu vi agijjhaṁ
taṁ tu anantara iyaraṁ paritta'nantaṁ ca vanakāē // PiṇḍNi.587
ahavaṇa sacittamīsō u ēgaō ēgaō u accittō
etthavi caukkabhaṅgō tatthāitiē kahā natthi // PiṇḍNi.588
jaṁ puṇa acittadavvaṁ nikkhippai cēyaṇēsu davvēsu
tahiṁ maggaṇā u iṇamō anantaraparamparā hōi // PiṇḍNi.589
ōgāhimāyanantaraṁ paramparaṁ piḍharagāi puḍhavīē
navanīyāi anantara paramparaṁ nāvāmāīsu // PiṇḍNi.590
vijjhāyamummuriṅgālamēva appattapattasamajālē
vokkantē sattadugaṁ jantōlittē ya jayaṇāē // PiṇḍNi.591
vijjhāutti na dīsai aggī dīsēi indhaṇē chūḍhē
āpiṅgala aganikaṇā mummura nijjāla iṅgālē // PiṇḍNi.592
appattā u cautthē jālā piḍharaṁ tu pañcamē pattā
chaṭṭhē puṇa kaṇṇasamā jālā samaicchiyā carimē ।। gāhā-594 // PiṇḍNi.593
pāsōlittakaḍāhē parisāḍī natthi tampiya visālaṁ
sō'viya aciracchūḍhō ucchurasō nāiusiṇō ya // PiṇḍNi.594
usiṇōdagampi dheppai guḍarasapariṇāmiyaṁ aṇaccusiṇaṁ
jaṁ ca aghaṭṭiyakannaṁ ghaṭṭiyapaḍaṇammi mā aggī // PiṇḍNi.595
pāsōlittakaḍāhē'naccusiṇē aparisāḍa'ghaṭṭantē
sōlasa bhaṅgavigappā paḍhamē'ṇunnā na sēsēsu // PiṇḍNi.596
payasamadugaabbhāsē māṇaṁ bhaṅgāṇa tēsimā rayaṇā
ēgantariyaṁ lahuguru duguṇā duguṇā ya vāmēsu // PiṇḍNi.597
duvihavirāhaṇa usiṇē chaḍḍaṇa hānī ya bhāṇabhēō ya
vāukkhittānantaraparamparā pappaḍiya vatthī // PiṇḍNi.598
hariyāi anantariyā paramparaṁ piḍharamāisu vaṇammi
pūpāī piṭṭha'nantara bhariē kuubāisū iyarā // PiṇḍNi.599
saccittē accittē mīsaga pihiyammi hōi caubhaṅgō
āitigē paḍisēhō carimē bhaṅgammi bhayaṇā u // PiṇḍNi.600
jaha cēva u nikkhittē sañjōgā cēva honti bhaṅgā ya
ēmēva ya pihiyammi vi nāṇattamiṇaṁ taiyabhaṅgē // PiṇḍNi.601
aṅgāradhūviyāī anantarō santarō sarāvāī
tatthēva airavāū paramparaṁ batthiṇā pihiē // PiṇḍNi.602
airaṁ phalāipihitaṁ vaṇammi iyaraṁ tu piccha piḍharāī
kacchavasañcārāī anantarānantarē chaṭṭhē // PiṇḍNi.603
guru guruṇā guru lahuṇā lahuyaṁ guruēṇa dō'vi lahuyāiṁ
accittēṇavi pihiē caubhaṅgō dōsu aggejjhaṁ // PiṇḍNi.604
saccittē accittē mīsaga sāhāraṇē ya caubhaṅgō
āitiē paḍisēhō carimē bhaṅgammi bhayaṇā u // PiṇḍNi.605
jaha cēva u nikkhittē sañjōgā cēva honti bhaṅgā ya
tahā cēva u sāharaṇē nāṇattamiṇaṁ taiyabhaṅgē // PiṇḍNi.606
mattēṇa jēṇa dāhii tattha adijjaṁ tu hojja asanāī
chōḍhu tayannahi tēṇaṁ dēī aha hōi sāharaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.607
bhūmāiēsu taṁ puṇa sāharaṇaṁ hōi chasu vi kāēsu
jaṁ taṁ duhā acittaṁ sāharaṇaṁ tattha caubhaṅgō // PiṇḍNi.608
sukkē sukkaṁ paḍhamō sukkē ullaṁ tu biiyaō bhaṅgō
ullē sukkaṁ taiō ullē ullaṁ cautthō u // PiṇḍNi.609
ekkekkē caubhaṅgō sukkāīēsu causu bhaṅgēsu
thōvē thōvaṁ thōvē bahuṁ ca vivarīya dō annē ।। gāhā-611 // PiṇḍNi.610
jattha u thōvē thōvaṁ sukkē ullaṁ ca chuhai taṁ gejjhaṁ
jai taṁ tu samukkhēuṁ thōvāhāraṁ dalai annaṁ // PiṇḍNi.611
ukkhēvē nikkhēvē mahallabhāṇammi luddha vaha ḍāhō
aciyattaṁ vocchēō chakkāyavahō ya gurumattē // PiṇḍNi.612
thōvē thōvaṁ chūḍhaṁ sukkaṁ ullaṁ tu taṁ tu āinnaṁ
bahuyaṁ tu aṇāinnaṁ kaḍadōsō sotti kāūṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.613
bālē vuḍḍhē mattē ummattē vēviē ya jariē ya
andhillaē pagaliē ārūḍhē pāuyāhiṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.614
hatthu'duniyalabaddhē vivajjiē cēva hatthapāēhiṁ
tērāsi guvviṇī bālavaccha bhuñjanti ghusulintī // PiṇḍNi.615
bhajjanti ya dalayantī kaṇḍantī cēva taha ya pīsantī
pījantī ruñcantī kattanti pamaddamāṇī ya // PiṇḍNi.616
chakkāyavaggahatthā samaṇaṭṭhā nikkhivittu tē cēva
tē cēvōgāhantī saṅghaṭṭantā'rabhantī ya // PiṇḍNi.617
saṁsattēṇa ya davvēṇa littahatthā ya littamattā ya
uvvattantī sāhāraṇaṁ va dintī ya cōriyayaṁ // PiṇḍNi.618
pāhuḍiyaṁ ca ṭhavantī sapaccavāyā paraṁ ca uddissa
ābhōgamanābhōgē dalantī vajjaṇijjā ē // PiṇḍNi.619
ēēsi dāyagāṇaṁ gahaṇaṁ kēsiñci hōi bhaiyavvaṁ
kēsiñcī aggahaṇaṁ tavvivarīē bhavē gahaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.620
kabbaṭṭhiga appāhaṇa dinnē annanna gahaṇa pajjattaṁ
khantiya maggaṇadinnē uḍḍāha paōsa cārabhaḍā // PiṇḍNi.621
thērō galantalālō kampaṇahatthō paḍijja vā dentō
apahutti ya aciyattaṁ ēgayarē vā ubhayaō vā // PiṇḍNi.622
avayāsa bhāṇabhēō vamanaṁ asuitti lōgagarihā ya
pantāvaṇaṁ ca mattē vamaṇavivajjā ya ummattē // PiṇḍNi.623
vēviya parisāḍaṇayā pāsē va chubhejjā bhāṇabhēō vā
ēmēva ya jariyammivi jarasaṅkamaṇaṁ ca uḍḍāhō // PiṇḍNi.624
uḍḍāha kāyapaḍaṇaṁ andhē bhēō ya pāsa chuhaṇaṁ ca
taddōsī saṅkamaṇaṁ galanta bhisa bhinnadēhē ya // PiṇḍNi.625
pāuyadurūḍhapaḍaṇaṁ baddhē pariyāva asui khiṁsā ya
karachinnāsui khiṁsā tē cciya pāyē'vi paḍaṇaṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.626
āyaparōbhayadōsā abhikkhagahaṇammi khōbhaṇa napuṁsē
lōgaduguñchā saṅkā ērisayā nūnamēē'vi ।। gāhā-628 // PiṇḍNi.627
guvviṇi gabbhē saṅghaṭṭaṇā u uṭṭhantuvēsamāṇīē
bālāī maṁsuḍaga majjārāī virāhejjā // PiṇḍNi.628
bhuñjantī āyamaṇē udagaṁ choṭṭīya lōgagarihā ya
ghusulantī saṁsattē karammi littē bhavē rasagā // PiṇḍNi.629
dagabīē saṅghaṭṭaṇa pīsaṇakaṇḍadala bhajjaṇē ḍahaṇaṁ
piñjanta ruñcaṇāī dinnē littē karē udagaṁ // PiṇḍNi.630
lōṇadagaaganivatthīphalāimacchāi sajiya hatthammi
pāēṇōgāhaṇayā saṅghaṭṭaṇa sēsakāēṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.631
khaṇamāṇī ārabhaē majjai dhōyai va siñcaē kiñci
chēyavisāraṇamāī chindai chaṭṭhē phuruphuruntē // PiṇḍNi.632
chakkāyavaggahatthā kēī kōlāikannalaiyāī
siddhatthagapupphāṇi ya sirammi dinnāiṁ vajjanti // PiṇḍNi.633
annē bhaṇanti dasasu vi ēsaṇadōsēsu natthi taggahaṇaṁ
tēna na vajjaṁ bhannai nanu gahaṇaṁ dāyagaggahaṇā // PiṇḍNi.634
saṁsajjimammi dēsē saṁsajjimadavvalittakaramattā
sañcārō ōyattaṇa ukkhippantē'vi tē cēva // PiṇḍNi.635
sādhāraṇaṁ bahūṇaṁ tattha u dōsā jahēva anisiṭṭhē
cōriyaē gahaṇāī bhayaē suṇhāi vā dantē // PiṇḍNi.636
pāhuḍiṭhaviyagadōsā tiriuḍḍhamahē tihā avāyāō
dhammiyamāī ṭhaviyaṁ parassa parasantiyaṁ vā'vi // PiṇḍNi.637
anukampā paḍinīyaṭṭhayā va tē kuṇai jāṇamāṇō'vi
ēsaṇadōsē biiō kuṇai u asaḍhō ayāṇantō // PiṇḍNi.638
bhikkhāmittē aviyālaṇā u bālēṇa dijjamāṇammi
sandiṭṭhē vā gahaṇaṁ aibahuya viyālaṇē'ṇunnā // PiṇḍNi.639
thēra pahu tharatharantē dhariē annēṇa daḍhasarīrē vā
avvattamattasaḍḍhē avimbhalē vā asāgariē // PiṇḍNi.640
suimbhaddagadittāī daḍhaggahē vēviē jarammi sivē
annadhariyaṁ tu saḍḍhō dēyandhō'nnēṇa vā dhariē // PiṇḍNi.641
maṇḍalapasūtikuṭṭhī'sāgariē pāuyāgaē ayalē
kamabaddhē saviyārē iyarē biṭṭhē asāgariē // PiṇḍNi.642
paṇḍaga appaḍisēvī vēlā thaṇajīvi iyara savvampi
ukkhittamanāvāē na kiñci laggaṁ ṭhavantīē // PiṇḍNi.643
pīsantī nippiṭṭhē phāsuṁ vā dhusulaṇē asaṁsattaṁ
kattaṇi asaṅkhacuṇṇaṁ cuṇṇaṁ vā jā acokkhaliṇī ।। gāhā-645 // PiṇḍNi.644
uvvaṭṭaṇi'saṁsattēṇa vā'vi aṭṭīllaē na ghaṭṭēi
piñjaṇapamaddaṇēsu ya pacchākammaṁ jahiṁ natthi // PiṇḍNi.645
sēsēsu ya paḍivakkhō na sambhavai kāyagahaṇamāīsu
paḍivakkhassa abhāvē niyamā u bhavē tayaggahaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.646
saccittē accittē mīsaga ummīsagammi caubhaṅgō
āitiē paḍisēhō carimē bhaṅgammi bhayaṇā u // PiṇḍNi.647
jaha cēva ya sañjōgā kāyāṇaṁ heṭṭhaō ya sāharaṇē
taha cēva ya ummīsē hōi visēsō imō tattha // PiṇḍNi.648
dāyavvamadāyavvaṁ ca dō'vi davvāiṁ dēi mīsēuṁ
ōyaṇakusuṇāīṇaṁ sāharaṇa tayaṇṇahiṁ chōḍhuṁ // PiṇḍNi.649
tampiya sukkē sukkaṁ bhaṅgā cattāri jaha u sāharaṇō
appabahuē'vi caurō tahēva āinna'ṇāinnē // PiṇḍNi.650
apariṇayampiya duvihaṁ davvē bhāvē ya duvihamekkekkaṁ
davvammi hōi chakkaṁ bhāvammi ya hōi sajjhilagā // PiṇḍNi.651
jīvattammi avigaē apariṇayaṁ pariṇayaṁ gaē jīvē
diṭṭhantō duddhadahī iya apariṇayaṁ pariṇayaṁ taṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.652
dugamāī sāmannē jai pariṇamaī u tattha ēgassa
dēmitti na sēsāṇaṁ apariṇayaṁ bhāvaō ēyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.653
ēgēṇa vā'vi ēsiṁ maṇammi pariṇāmiyaṁ na iyarēṇaṁ
tampi hu hōi agijjhaṁ sajjhilagā sāmi sāhū vā // PiṇḍNi.654
ghettavvamalēvakaḍaṁ lēvakaḍē mā hu pacchakammāī
na ya rasagēhipasaṅgō ia vuttē cōyagō bhaṇai // PiṇḍNi.655
jai pacchakammadōsā havanti mā cēva bhuñjaū sayayaṁ
tavaniyamasañjamāṇaṁ cōyaga! hānī khamantassa // PiṇḍNi.656
littanti bhāṇiūṇaṁ chammāsā hāyaē cautthaṁ tu
āyambilassa gahaṇaṁ asantharē appalēvaṁ tu // PiṇḍNi.657
āyambilapāraṇaē chammāsa nirantaraṁ tu khaviūṇaṁ
jai na tarai chammāsē ēgadinūnaṁ taō kuṇau // PiṇḍNi.658
ēvaṁ ekkekkadinaṁ āyambilapāraṇaṁ khavēūṇaṁ
divasē divasē giṇhau āyambilamēva nillēvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.659
jai sē na jōgahānī sampai ēsē va hōi tō khamaō
khamaṇantarēṇa āyambilaṁ tu niyamaṁ tavaṁ kuṇai // PiṇḍNi.660
heṭṭhāvaṇi kōlasagā sōvīragakūrabhōiṇō manuyā
jai tē'vi javenti tahā kiṁ nāma jaī na jāvinti? ।। gāhā-662 // PiṇḍNi.661
tiya sīyaṁ samaṇāṇaṁ tiya uṇha gihīṇa tēṇa'ṇunnāyaṁ
takkāīṇaṁ gahaṇaṁ kaṭṭaramāīsu bhaiyavvaṁ // PiṇḍNi.662
āhārauvahisejjā tinni vi uṇhā gihīṇa sīē'vi
tēṇa u jīrai tēsiṁ duhaō usiṇēṇa āhārō // PiṇḍNi.663
ēyāiṁ ciya tinni vi jaīṇa sīyāiṁ honti gimhē vi
tēṇuvahammai aggī taō ya dōsā ajīrāī // PiṇḍNi.664
ōyaṇa maṇḍaga sattuga kummāsārāya māsakalavaṭṭā
tūyarimasūramuggā māsā ya alēvaḍā sukkā // PiṇḍNi.665
ubbhijjapijjakaṅgū takkollaṇasūvakañji kaḍhiyāī
ēē u appalēvā pacchākammaṁ tahiṁ bhaiyaṁ // PiṇḍNi.666
khīra dahi jāu kaṭṭara tella ghēyaṁ phāṇiyaṁ sapiṇḍarasaṁ
iccāī bahulēvaṁ pacchākammaṁ tahiṁ niyamā // PiṇḍNi.667
saṁsaṭṭhēyarahatthō mattō'viya davva sāvasēsiyaraṁ
ēēsu aṭṭha bhaṅgā niyamā gahaṇaṁ tu ōēsu // PiṇḍNi.668
saccittē accittē mīsaga taha chaḍḍaṇē ya caubhaṅgō
caubhaṅgē paḍisēhō gahaṇē āṇāiṇō dōsā // PiṇḍNi.669
usiṇassa chaḍḍaṇē dentaō va ḍajjhejjha kāyadāhō vā
sīyapaḍaṇammi kāyā paḍiē mahubinduāharaṇaṁ // PiṇḍNi.670
nāmaṁ ṭhavaṇā daviē bhāvē ghāsēsaṇā muṇēyavvā
davvē macchāharaṇaṁ bhāvammi ya hōi pañcavihā // PiṇḍNi.671
cariyaṁ va kappiyaṁ vā āharaṇaṁ duvihamēva nāyavvaṁ
atthassa sāhaṇaṭṭhā indhaṇamiva ōyaṇaṭṭhāē // PiṇḍNi.672
aha maṁsammi pahīṇē jhāyantaṁ macchiyaṁ bhaṇai macchō
kiṁ jhāyasiṁ taṁ ēvaṁ? suṇa tāva jahā ahiriō'si // PiṇḍNi.673
tibalāgamuhummukkō tikkhuttō valayāmuhē
tisattakkhuttō jālēṇaṁ sai chinnōdaē dahē // PiṇḍNi.674
ēyārisaṁ mamaṁ sattaṁ saḍhaṁ ghaṭṭiyaghaṭṭaṇaṁ
icchasi galēṇa ghettuṁ ahō tē ahirīyayā // PiṇḍNi.675
bāyālīsēsaṇasaṅkaḍammi gahaṇammi jīva! na hu chaliō
iṇhiṁ jaha na chalijjasi bhuñjantō rāgadōsēhiṁ // PiṇḍNi.676
ghāsēsaṇā u bhāvē hōi pasatthā tahēva apasatthā
apasatthā pañcavihā tavvivarīyā pasatthāu // PiṇḍNi.677
davvē bhāvē sañjōaṇā u davvē duhā u bahi antō
bhikkhaṁ ciya hiṇḍantō sañjōyantammi bāhiriyā ।। gāhā-679 // PiṇḍNi.678
khīradahisūvakaṭṭaralambhē guḍasappivaḍagavāluṅkē
antō u tihā pāē lambaṇa vayaṇē vibhāsā u // PiṇḍNi.679
saṁyōyaṇāē dōsō jō sañjōēi bhattapānaṁ tu
davvāī rasahēuṁ vāghāō tassimō hōi // PiṇḍNi.680
sañjōyaṇā u bhāvē sañjōēūṇa tāni davvāiṁ
sañjōyai kammēṇaṁ kammēṇa bhavaṁ taō dukkhaṁ // PiṇḍNi.681
pattē ya pauralambhē bhuttuvvariē ya sēsagamaṇaṭṭhā
diṭṭhō sañjōgō khalu ahakkamō tassimō hōi // PiṇḍNi.682
rasahēuṁ paḍisiddhō saṁyōgō kappaē gilāṇaṭṭhā
jassa va abhattachandō suhōciō'bhāviō jō ya // PiṇḍNi.683
battīsaṁ kira kavalā āhārō kucchipūraō bhaṇiō
purisassa mahiliyāē aṭṭhāvīsaṁ bhavē kavalā // PiṇḍNi.684
ettō kiṇāi hīnaṁ addhaṁ addha'ddhagaṁ ca āhāraṁ
sāhussa binti dhīrā jāyāmāyaṁ ca ōmaṁ ca // PiṇḍNi.685
pagāmaṁ ca nigāmaṁ ca jō paṇīyaṁ bhattapānamāhārē
aibahuyaṁ aibahusō pamāṇadōsō muṇēyavvō // PiṇḍNi.686
battīsāi parēṇaṁ pagāma niccaṁ tamēva u nikāmaṁ
jaṁ puṇa galantanēhaṁ paṇīyamiti taṁ buhā benti // PiṇḍNi.687
aibahuyaṁ aibahusō aippamāṇēṇa bhōyaṇaṁ bhottuṁ
hāejja va vāmijja va mārijja va taṁ ajīrantaṁ // PiṇḍNi.688
bahuyātīyamaibahuṁ aibahusō tinni tinni va parēṇaṁ
taṁ ciya aippamāṇaṁ bhuñjai jaṁ vā atippantō // PiṇḍNi.689
hiyāhārā miyāhārā appāhārā ya jē narā
na tē vijjā tigicchanti appāṇaṁ tē tigicchagā // PiṇḍNi.690
telladahisamāōgā ahiō kharīdahikañjiyāṇaṁ ca
patthaṁ puṇa rōgaharaṁ na ya hēū hōi rōgassa // PiṇḍNi.691
addhamasaṇassa savvañjanassa kujjā davassa dō bhāgē
vāūpaviyāraṇaṭṭhā chabbhāyaṁ ūṇayaṁ kujjā // PiṇḍNi.692
sīō usiṇō sāhāraṇō ya kālō tihā muṇēyavvō
sāhāraṇammi kālē tatthāhārē imā mattā // PiṇḍNi.693
sīē davassa ēgō bhattē cattāri ahava dō pāṇē
usiṇē davassa donni u tinni va sēsā u bhattassa // PiṇḍNi.694
ēgō davassa bhāgō uvaṭṭhitō bhōyaṇassa dō bhāgā
vaḍḍhanti va hāyanti va dō dō bhāgā u ekkekkē ।। gāhā-696 // PiṇḍNi.695
tattha u taiyacautthā donni ya aṇavaṭṭhiyā bhavē bhāgā
pañcamachaṭṭhō paḍhamō biiō vi avaṭṭhiyā bhāgā // PiṇḍNi.696
taṁ hōi saiṅgālaṁ jaṁ āhārēi mucchiō santō
taṁ puṇa hōi sadhūmaṁ jaṁ āhārēi nindantō // PiṇḍNi.697
aṅgārattamapattaṁ jalamāṇaṁ indhaṇaṁ sadhūmaṁ tu
aṅgāratti pavuccai taṁ ciya daḍḍhaṁ gaē dhūmē // PiṇḍNi.698
rāgaggisampalittō bhuñjantō phāsuyampi āhāraṁ
niddaḍḍhaṅgālanibhaṁ karēi caraṇindhaṇaṁ khippaṁ // PiṇḍNi.699
dōsaggīvi jalantō appattiyadhūmadhūmiyaṁ caraṇaṁ
aṅgāramittasarisaṁ jā na havai niddahī tāva // PiṇḍNi.700
rāgēṇa saiṅgālaṁ dōsēṇa sadhūmagaṁ muṇēyavvaṁ
chāyālīsaṁ dōsā boddhavvā bhōyaṇavihīē // PiṇḍNi.701
āhāranti tavassī vigaiṅgālaṁ ca vigayadhūmaṁ ca
jhāṇajjhayaṇanimittaṁ ēsuvaēsō pavayaṇassa // PiṇḍNi.702
chahiṁ kāraṇēhiṁ sādhū āhārintō vi āyarai dhammaṁ
chahiṁ cēva kāraṇēhiṁ nijjūhintō vi āyarai // PiṇḍNi.703
vēyaṇa vēyāvaccē iriyaṭṭhāē ya sañjamaṭṭhāē
taha pāṇavattiyāē chaṭṭhaṁ puṇa dhammacintāē // PiṇḍNi.704
natthi chuhāē sarisā viyaṇā bhuñjejja tappasamaṇaṭṭhā
chāō vēyāvaccaṁ na tarai kāuṁ aō bhuñjē // PiṇḍNi.705
iriaṁ navi sōhēī pēhāīaṁ ca sañjamaṁ kāuṁ
chāō vā parihāyai guṇaṇuppēhāsu a asattō // PiṇḍNi.706
ahava ṇa kujjāhāraṁ chahiṁ ṭhāṇēhiṁ sañjaē
pacchā pacchimakālammi kāuṁ appakkhamaṁ khamaṁ // PiṇḍNi.707
āyaṅkē uvasaggē titikkhayā bambhacēraguttīsu
pāṇidayā tavahēuṁ sarīravocchēyaṇaṭṭhāē // PiṇḍNi.708
āyaṅkō jaramāī rāyāsannāyagāi uvasaggō
bambhavayapālaṇaṭṭhā pāṇidayā vāsamahiyāī // PiṇḍNi.709
tavahēu cautthāī jāva u chammāsiō tavō hōi
chaṭṭhaṁ sarīravocchēyaṇaṭṭhayā hō aṇāhārō // PiṇḍNi.710
sōlasa uggamadōsā sōlasa uppāyaṇāē dōsā u
dasa ēsaṇāē dōsā sañjōyaṇamāi pañcēva // PiṇḍNi.711
ēsō āhāravihī jaha bhaṇiō savvabhāvadaṁsīhiṁ
dhammāvassagajōgā jēṇa na hāyanti taṁ kujjā // PiṇḍNi.712
jā jayamāṇassa bhavē virāhaṇā suttavihisamaggassa
sā hōi nijjaraphalā ajjhatthavisōhijuttassa // PiṇḍNi.713
